invariants.rationale: All possible return statements produce non-null values; each referenced style field is only returned if non-null.

invariants.expression: result == style.checkboxOnDisabled || result == style.checkboxOffDisabled || result == style.checkboxOnOver || result == style.checkboxOn || result == style.checkboxOver || result == style.checkboxOff
invariants.rationale: The only possible return values are the style checkbox Drawable fields.

invariants.expression: !(isDisabled()) || result == style.checkboxOn || result == style.checkboxOff || result == style.checkboxOnOver || result == style.checkboxOver
invariants.rationale: If not disabled, the result must come from 'checkboxOn', 'checkboxOff', 'checkboxOnOver', or 'checkboxOver'.
The result can only be 'checkboxOnDisabled' or 'checkboxOffDisabled' if the checkbox is disabled.

invariants.expression: isChecked || result != style.checkboxOn && result != style.checkboxOnDisabled && result != style.checkboxOnOver
invariants.rationale: The 'On' variants only occur as results if isChecked is true; otherwise, they cannot be returned.
